name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: Fixed Wallpaper Generation & Startup Sync: Restored automatic instant download and wallpaper change upon launch without waiting for the 60-minute timer
Enabled Modern TLS 1.2/1.3 Protocols: Initialized ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol to guarantee 100% success on Cloudflare-protected Wallhaven API, Unsplash, and Picsum endpoints

Multi-Tier Resilient 4K Downloader: Implemented 6-tier fallback engine (Wallhaven Random Search -> Wallhaven Pool -> Picsum UHD -> Unsplash 4K -> Local Cache -> Generated Gradient) ensuring zero failures even offline
Screen-Calibrated Calendar HUD: Dynamically scales source wallpaper to primary screen resolution in memory before rendering HUD, eliminating distortion and clipping
Dual Alternating Desktop Slots: Alternates between active_desktop_hud_A.jpg and active_desktop_hud_B.jpg to bypass Windows Desktop path caching and eliminate GDI+ file locking
Legacy GIN-Wallpaper Cleaner: Automatically terminates leftover GIN-Wallpaper processes, cleans obsolete autostart registry entries, and purges old desktop shortcuts
